scope: Kestrel Mutual demo data-sharing and vendor policies
summary: The plan shares customer data externally without the data-owner approval that clause 4.2 requires.

findings.title: Data-owner approval is absent
findings.rationale: You stated the data owner has not approved the share. Clause 4.2 requires recorded approval before any transfer.

findings.title: Vendor review status is unknown
findings.rationale: Brightline Analytics must hold Approved status before receiving customer data. Nobody has confirmed its status.
missing_facts: Vendor register status for Brightline Analytics

findings.title: Purpose and fields are not yet recorded
findings.rationale: You named the fields and the purpose, but clause 4.3 needs them recorded with an approval, which does not exist yet.

findings.title: Legal disclosure exception does not apply
findings.rationale: No law or regulator request is involved, so the exception in clause 4.4 is not triggered.

citations.quote: requires written approval from the data owner, recorded in the data-sharing register before any transfer takes place
hold Approved status in the vendor register, before receiving customer data
The purpose and the field list must be recorded with the approval
Transfers required by law or by a regulator’s written request follow the Legal Disclosure Procedure
any transfer of, or remote access to, customer data by a party outside Kestrel Mutual, including vendors

risks.description: Customer data would leave the organization without the owner’s recorded approval.
If the vendor is unreviewed, data would reach a party whose controls nobody has checked.

recommendations.action: Get written approval from the data owner and record it in the data-sharing register before any transfer.
recommendations.completion_criteria: An approval entry for this share exists in the register.

recommendations.action: Confirm Brightline Analytics holds Approved status in the vendor register. If it does not, start a vendor review.
recommendations.completion_criteria: The register shows Approved status within the last twelve months.

recommendations.action: Record the purpose (churn modelling) and the three fields with the approval.
recommendations.completion_criteria: The register entry lists the purpose and the field list.

limitations: Only Kestrel Mutual’s demo data-sharing and vendor policies were assessed.
Results use policy snapshot snapshot_demo_v1 as of 25 Sep 2026.
